summary: Learn mode never synthesises a lesson against AvalAI. The writer's structured-output call fails on every turn, so `write_explanation` falls back to displaying the local curated passages. This is a deterministic provider/schema incompatibility, not a transient outage.

isolation.not_prompt_size: A trivial {ok: bool} schema succeeds with a 19,615-character prompt.
isolation.not_schema_size_generally: Nested objects and arrays of concrete models succeed (cases D, E, F).
isolation.cause: `LessonDraft.block_requests: list[Any]` serialises to `"items": {}`, an untyped array item. AvalAI rejects that request with 400 invalid_request or 503 service_unavailable (it returns both for the same input). Removing that one property makes the same call succeed (case A).

verified_workaround.finding: `with_structured_output(schema, method="function_calling")` succeeds where the default method fails, on the unmodified LessonDraft schema.
verified_workaround.attempted_fix_that_did_not_work: Re-typing block_requests as a model with all-optional `str | None` fields still fails: the resulting `anyOf` item schema is also rejected.

side_observation: One probe returned HTTP 429 'insufficient credit' for the AvalAI account; the account balance is worth checking before a long live run.
impact: Answer mode is unaffected (its schema has no untyped array). Only the learn-mode writer is degraded, and it degrades safely: the reply still carries the curated content, with an explicit warning.
